notes: Expressions allow at most 500 characters; string literals at most 200 characters. Player-choice prompts allow at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes and option labels at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, including after interpolation.
Source mappings require unique text field names and finite JSON-compatible values. Maximum nesting is 64 levels and 250,000 value nodes; cyclic aliases reject.
After family expansion, the shared runtime validator owns parameters, preconditions, effects, expressions, references, and execution bounds.

Mechanic families expand into tools. Optional procedures use literal package_runtime procedure declarations, including steps and narrative, copied unchanged without family/configure token substitution. Omission emits an empty procedures map.
Family objects have exactly four fields, even when no operation references the family.
Family references and operation-name uniqueness require procedural checks.
Unused configure keys and every unresolved token are not separately rejected by the current compiler.
Participant schemas use the package admission subset and their $id must match schema_id. The materializer derives schema_sha256; do not author it.
Panel depth, node count, references, placement support, and cross-tree uniqueness remain procedural checks.
